title: Ufo Sighting
concept: A solitary observer wanders through shifting geological and celestial realms that oscillate between sacred permanence and cosmic indifference.
style: A recurring figure appears throughout: An elderly person with weathered skin, wearing a heavy, oversized linen shroud in a pale cream color..

scenes.still_prompt: An expansive white salt crust under a bruised lavender sky at twilight.
beats: Wide shot: the figure stands motionless in the center of the vast white expanse
Medium shot: the figure slowly drags a hand across the cracked salt surface
Close up: the figure's feet sinking slightly into the crystalline crust
Low angle shot: the figure tilts their head toward the darkening horizon
Wide shot: the figure becomes a small speck against the monumental white ground
scenes.video_prompt: Fine white salt dust swirls in low, rhythmic gusts across the ground. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: The camera drifts laterally across the flat horizon.

scenes.still_prompt: A narrow gorge of polished black volcanic rock reflecting a sliver of moonlight.
beats: Long shot: the figure enters the dark canyon from the top of the frame
Medium shot: the figure runs a hand along the sharp, reflective canyon wall
Close up: the figure's eyes reflecting the glint of wet stone
Medium shot: the figure stops to look upward at the narrow strip of sky
Wide shot: the figure walks deeper into the narrowing black crevice
scenes.video_prompt: Thin wisps of condensation drip from the high canyon walls. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.mid: The camera tracks forward steadily behind the figure.

scenes.still_prompt: The ruins of a stone basilica where sunlight pierces through high, empty window frames.
beats: Wide shot: the figure walks through a shaft of colored light on the stone floor
Medium shot: the figure reaches up toward a beam of crimson light
Close up: the figure's face illuminated by shifting patterns of sapphire and amber
Medium shot: the figure kneels on the debris-strewn floor
Wide shot: the figure stands amidst the rising dust motes in the light
scenes.video_prompt: Heavy beams of light dance with thick, suspended particles of dust. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.mid: The camera circles the figure in a slow, sweeping arc.

scenes.still_prompt: A vast, red sand dune sea under a sky filled with swirling dark storm clouds.
beats: Wide shot: the figure struggles to walk against a heavy wind on a dune crest
Medium shot: the figure wraps the linen shroud tightly around their body
Close up: the figure's hands clawing into the shifting red sand
Low angle shot: the figure stumbles forward through the thickening haze
Wide shot: the figure disappears into a wall of dark, moving sand
scenes.video_prompt: A violent storm of red sand lashes across the landscape. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.high: The camera shakes and darts erratically through the wind.

scenes.still_prompt: An infinite expanse of deep violet space punctuated by distant, unblinking white stars.
beats: Wide shot: the figure floats weightlessly in the center of the darkness
Medium shot: the figure reaches out toward a distant glowing nebula
Close up: the figure's eyes reflecting a bright, distant star cluster
Wide shot: the figure drifts slowly away from the camera into the void
Extreme wide shot: the figure becomes a single, tiny point of light
scenes.video_prompt: Faint, rhythmic pulses of light emanate from distant celestial bodies. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: The camera pulls back extremely slowly into the darkness.
